flaws.description: Swapped sns.lineplot for sns.scatterplot at its single call site, removing the markersize=8 keyword (not accepted by scatterplot) while keeping linewidth and marker; this turns the connected trend lines into an unconnected scatter of points.

Swapped the 'Qatar' and 'Rwanda' keys in the data dictionary (keeping their value lists in place), so the melted 'Country' labels—and thus the legend and hue colors—are exchanged between the two series while the underlying line values are unchanged.
Changed the Tanzania 2014 value in the inline data list from 68.8 to 31.0 (0.45x), corrupting a single plotted data point while leaving table.csv unchanged.
